claims.claim: A blue electronic piano with all blue songs and other songs preloaded
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a blue plastic toy panel with colorful graphics and black button/slots, but no readable model/brand or visible evidence of preloaded songs.
No visible instructional content, screen, or readable mode labels in the photos.
Photos show buttons/slots but do not show them being pressed or any functioning indicators (lights/sound).
No adapter or charger is shown in the witness photos.
No UK-specific markings, packaging, or readable label details are visible.
No audio test, speaker output, or key-by-key demonstration is shown.

risks.risk: Not actually electronic/working (no sound/lights), or speaker/buzzer failure
risks.proof: Short video clip: press several different buttons/keys and show any lights plus clearly audible sound (or a volume change) from the speaker area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-working/untested learning toy (worst case).

risks.risk: Missing adapter/incorrect power supply (or batteries required but not included)
risks.proof: Photo/clip of the exact adapter/charger (label with voltage/amp) and/or open battery compartment showing battery type and condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as missing power accessory (worst case).

risks.risk: Some keys/buttons may be stuck, intermittent, or not responding
risks.proof: Video clip: press every key/button in sequence (or at least all rows) with on-screen/visible response (sound/light) for each.

risks.risk: Cracks, loose parts, or internal damage not visible from the outside
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all edges, corners, and the front button area plus a clip showing the toy being gently flexed/handled while operating.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/with hidden defects (worst case).

risks.risk: Wrong item category/model (could be a generic learning panel rather than a piano with full keybed)
risks.proof: Photo of the front showing the full key/button layout and any printed model name; include a shot of the label area with readable text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic children’s electronic learning toy (worst case).

proof_requests: Send a short video showing the toy powered on, with sound and/or lights working.
Show a clip pressing multiple different keys/buttons (ideally all) with audible/visible response.
Provide clear photos of the label area with readable brand/model text (front and back).
Confirm power method: photo of battery compartment (if any) and/or the exact adapter/charger included (with voltage/amp label).
Send close-ups of all edges/corners and the button/slot area to check for cracks or loose parts.
response.reason: The witness photos confirm a blue children’s electronic-style toy panel, but they do not prove it is a working electronic piano, nor that all keys/buttons work, nor that an adapter is included. Without a power-on test clip and readable label/power details, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
